mentions.name: Blazor Investment Tracker
mentions.description: A Blazor CRUD web app that tracks the user's investments in index funds, stocks, and ETFs. Most of its Entity Framework-backed CRUD pages were generated with AI coding tools (Grok, Copilot), with fixes by Claude 4 and review by the C# developer author.
mentions.audience: The author, for tracking their own investments
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm vibe coding using GitHub Copilot and JetBrains AI Pro on a Blazor web app that tracks my investment in like index funds, stocks, ETFs, etc. It's a simple CRUD web app.

evidence.value: I'm vibe coding using GitHub Copilot and JetBrains AI Pro on a Blazor web app that tracks my investment in like index funds, stocks, ETFs, etc. It's a simple CRUD web app.
